notes.title: Update plan
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.
We have received lots of feedback about the lack of interaction with cats, so we will first add the petting cat feature and add cat meowing into the BGM at home on 2022/11/15. The next update will focus on interacting with cats.

NEXT 
December update:
More interaction with cats (pick the cat up, the cat follows the player, etc.)
More cat behaviors (each cat will have its own unique animation)
More furniture (there will be a function for cats to interact with furniture)
more cats
English localization troubleshooting

We are sorry about English localization. The current English translation is not localized correctly. There are still some grammar and script errors that may affect players’ gameplay. We are sorry for that, and promise will fix them and update as soon as possible. 
Thanks for your understanding.

THEN
Long-term goals:
Player costume
Cat costume
Store growth system
More levels
More interaction with guests
More mini-games (currently drink making and toilet cleaning)
Ice cream auxiliary mode (the ice cream delivery area has been enlarged once, but there are still many feedback, so we consider adding auxiliary functions so that players can choose)
Keybinding, etc.

Finally, thank you for your support and feedback, and we hope you are enjoying Meowjiro so far!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43067319/f991371c42dad6634ba07ed807ff8cd95a51aee1.gif[/img]

notes.title: Increase the ice cream delivery area!
notes.notes:
1. Ice Cream:
     (1) Increase the delivery area and the cone.
     (2) Cannot pick up delivered ice cream.
2. The money display in the setting menu is updated instantly.
3. Adjust the content layout of the SMS and the news to accommodate longer articles.
4. The mini-game will be automatically closed when player goes home.
5. The sound effects are fully played across scenes.
6. Microwave sound effect:
     (1) There will be a microwave sound effect in the microwave, and the volume can be set in the setting.
     (2) Add a hot food sizzling sound.
7. Delay the background music plays at the store.
